Resolutions of 1958

5 resolutions, 60% unanimous. Founding and early Cold War.

  • 127 (1958) The zone between the armistice demarcation lines in the area of Government House at Jerusalem
  • 128 (1958) Complaint by Lebanon in respect of a situation arising from interference of the United Arab Republic (Egypt) in the internal affairs of Lebanon
  • 129 (1958) An emergency special session of the General Assembly on complaints by Lebanon and Jordan
  • 130 (1958) Election of members of the International Court of Justice
  • 131 (1958) Admission of Guinea to membership in the United Nations
